title: Invariance of the signed inner product under reindexing
statement:
Let $m$ and $n$ be natural numbers with $m = n$, and let $x, y \colon \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \mathrm{Bool}$ be two $n$-bit strings, writing $\langle x, y\rangle$ for their signed inner product. The equality $m = n$ gives a bijection $\sigma \colon \mathrm{Fin}\,m \to \mathrm{Fin}\,n$, and precomposing with it turns $x$ and $y$ into the $m$-bit strings $x \circ \sigma$ and $y \circ \sigma$. Then reindexing both strings in this way leaves the signed inner product unchanged:
\[
  \langle x \circ \sigma,\; y \circ \sigma\rangle \;=\; \langle x, y\rangle.
\]
hypotheses_covered: m and n are natural numbers
x, y are n-bit strings (functions Fin n → Bool)
